messages.subject: CFA MLR estimation Error
parts:
Hello, 

I am trying to run a CFA model using the robust maximum likelihood estimation option (MLR). For some reason I am unable to do so, the console gives me an error message that I do not know what it means. Here is the error message: 

> fit <- cfa(model1, data=fdg, estimator="MLR")
Error in t(A1.inv) : object 'A1.inv' not found

I am able to run a regular maximum likelihood CFA model, but I could not run the MLR estimation. 

Does anyone know what the error message means or can help me with this? 

Thank you,
Muhammad
